summary: v43 Outbound Filtering + Bulk Detection tested end-to-end. Created pytest suite (11 tests) covering ingest direction, backward compat, migrate-direction idempotency, stats, filtered events search, bulk detection with auto-throttle + hour-bucket dedupe, manual throttle add/remove, event actions (delete/quarantine/whitelist_sender/throttle_sender), and legacy /outbound regression. All 11 backend tests PASS. Frontend Playwright verified /panel/outbound renders with all 5 stat cards, filter bar, adv panel toggle, saved filters, events tbody with 34 rows, per-row 4 action buttons (quar/wl/throt/del) using dynamic event ids, throttle modal open→submit→row appears→unthrottle removes row (with success toast). All data-testids present and functional.

issues: React dev-overlay causes hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Comes from Emergent visual-editor injecting <span data-ve-dynamic> inside <option>{n} kayıt</option> at Outbound.js:193. Harmless in production build; may be silenced by wrapping option label in a template literal-only render or disabling ve-dynamic for options.

critical_code_review_comments: outbound.py migrate-direction imports _require_master from server.py at call-time (line 374). Works but creates tight coupling; consider moving _require_master into a shared deps/auth module.

Bulk detection block in events.py:326-374 is embedded in ingest_event. For high-throughput ingest, this synchronous check + insert adds latency; consider offloading to background task or bulk-aggregation cron.

outbound_stats uses cache TTL 15s but throttle add/remove invalidates only own license_key cache — if MASTER views aggregated stats, MASTER cache key `outbound:stats:{MASTER_LICENSE_KEY}` may still be stale for up to 15s (throttled_users count). Currently acceptable.

outbound.py:363 cache delete key uses `ev.get('license_key') or 'MASTER'` while stats writes with `lic_key or 'MASTER'` — key parity OK, but if event has license_key but scope is master viewing, cache under license_key is invalidated instead of MASTER cache. Consider invalidating both.
Outbound.js LICKEY() reads from localStorage — no server-side auth check on the frontend; relies on backend X-Master-Key. Ensure sensitive cookie/master session is set for prod usage.
seed_data_creation: Test suite creates TEST_-prefixed outbound mail_events, master_alerts (type=outbound_bulk), and outbound_throttles. Cleanup step (test_cleanup_zzz) removes test throttles and restores policy.outbound_limit_per_hour to original value.
context_for_next_testing_agent: v43 Outbound module fully functional. To trigger bulk detection: PUT /api/settings with full PolicySettings body including outbound_limit_per_hour=5, ingest N>=5 events with direction='out' + same from_user + same license_key, then GET /api/outbound/bulk-alerts. Restore limit via PUT /api/settings. Frontend at /panel/outbound requires localStorage.gws.master_license set to master key for X-Master-Key auth.
